summary.text: Charlie Schmidt is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 77, representing part of Chesterfield County and part of the city of Richmond, serving since January 17, 2026. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Communications, Technology and Innovation, and Courts of Justice.

paragraphs.text: Charles H. "Charlie" Schmidt Jr. was born in Houston, according to the House's member profile.
The profile says he earned a B.A. in history and political science from Virginia Commonwealth University in 2004 and a J.D. from Charlotte School of Law in 2012, and lists his occupation as attorney.
